items.title: AI Is Putting Pressure on the Corporate IT Budget
items.summary: When research and advisory firm Gartner released its latest forecast last month, it projected that global IT spending is expected to reach $6.37 trillion in 2026, up 14.2% from 2025.  Such growth reflects the historic level of spending on AI infrastructure across the board.  “Despite the strong growth in spending, this is not a ‘rising tide lifts all boats’ market trend,”  Gartner  Chief Forecaster John-David Lovelock said about the report.
